metadata.name: agentspay
metadata.description: Attestation-gated, metered payments for AI agents on Solana

accounts.name: attestation
docs: Required by `refund_credits` when the provider has an active attestation.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: Required by `refund_credits` when the provider has an active attestation.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone can crank a settlement; funds only ever flow to the provider
payout and the treasury, bounded by both signatures.

types.name: AgentVault
docs: Owner-funded budget an agent can spend from under a policy, without the
owner signing every session. The owner can freeze or drain it at any time.

fields.name: period_limit
docs: Max deposits per rolling period; ignored when `period_seconds == 0`.

fields.name: min_provider_rating
docs: Minimum paid-feedback average (0 disables the check).

fields.name: allowed_tee_mask
docs: Bit i set = `TeeType` i allowed. 0 = any non-simulated type allowed by config.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Unix timestamp after which the agent can no longer open sessions (0 = never).

types.name: Attestation
docs: Hardware attestation binding an enclave-held key to an approved workload.
The TEE quote's `REPORTDATA` must commit to
`sha256("agentspay:attest:v1" || provider || enclave_key || encryption_key)`
so the verifiers can prove the keys were generated inside the enclave.

fields.name: enclave_key
docs: Ed25519 key that never leaves the enclave; signs usage receipts.

fields.name: encryption_key
docs: X25519 key for sealing prompts to the enclave (private inference).

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the raw evidence bundle (quote + GPU report + collateral).

types.name: Config
docs: Global protocol configuration (singleton PDA).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Wallet that owns protocol-fee token accounts.

fields.name: verifiers
docs: Attestation verifier committee.

fields.name: verifier_threshold
docs: Approvals required to mark an attestation valid.

fields.name: max_attestation_ttl
docs: Upper bound on attestation lifetime (seconds).

fields.name: allow_simulated_tee
docs: Allow `TeeType::Simulated` (localnet / devnet only).

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new sessions / credit sales. Exits always stay open.

fields.name: refund
docs: true = default refund to a holder, false = provider/treasury cash-out.

types.name: Measurement
docs: Governance-approved workload measurement: a reproducible build of the
inference server + model weights that providers are allowed to run.
Revoking a measurement instantly invalidates every attestation that
carries it (e.g. after a CVE or TCB recall).

fields.name: model_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the model weights / manifest served by this workload.

types.name: Offering
docs: Tokenized compute capacity ("GPU-hours"): an SPL mint whose supply is
fully collateralised by buyer payments held in escrow. Credits are spent
in attested sessions; the provider converts credits it earned back into
the payment token, and holders can refund if the provider defaults.

fields.name: price_per_credit
docs: Payment-token base units per credit (credits have 0 decimals).

fields.name: unit
docs: Human-readable unit, e.g. "h100-gpu-second" or "1k-tokens:llama-3.1-70b".

fields.name: salt
docs: Disambiguates concurrent sessions between the same payer and provider.

fields.name: price_per_unit
docs: Price in token base units per metered unit (agreed off-chain via the 402 challenge).

fields.name: authorized_signer
docs: Key that signs vouchers (an agent's hot / ephemeral key).

types.name: PaidFeedback
docs: Payment-backed feedback. Each rating is bound to a session that actually
settled value through an attested enclave, so indexers can forward it to
the 8004 reputation registry with an unforgeable proof-of-payment link.

types.name: Provider
docs: A compute provider (GPU operator) offering attested inference.

fields.name: payout
docs: Wallet receiving settlements.

fields.name: agent_asset
docs: Optional 8004 / Metaplex Core agent asset representing this provider's identity.

fields.name: active_attestation
docs: Most recently validated attestation (default pubkey when none).

fields.name: forced_closes
docs: Sessions closed without provider cooperation (grace expiry or invalid attestation).

fields.name: ratings_count
docs: Ratings are only accepted from payers whose sessions actually settled payment.

types.name: Session
docs: An attestation-gated metered payment session (a unidirectional payment
channel whose settlement additionally requires an enclave-signed receipt).

fields.name: payer
docs: Refund owner: the payer wallet, or the `AgentVault` PDA for vault-funded sessions.

fields.name: vault
docs: `AgentVault` PDA when vault-funded, default otherwise.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Account that paid rent; receives it back on finalize.

fields.name: enclave_key
docs: Snapshot of `attestation.enclave_key` (receipt signer).

fields.name: authorized_signer
docs: Voucher signer (usually an agent's ephemeral session key).

fields.name: settled
docs: Cumulative amount paid out (gross, including protocol fee).

fields.name: transcript_hash
docs: Last enclave transcript hash committed on-chain (audit trail).
